text:
Maya Chen: UX quickcheck — support flagged that users are unsure about our "staged revocation" option in the rotate flow. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/staged-revoke.png
Samir Patel: Right now the checkbox label is technical. People don't grasp "staged revocation" vs "immediate revoke". We need clearer affordances.
Jamie Ortiz: Accessibility: whatever copy we choose must be announced when toggled. Suggest a short live text: 'Old key will be disabled immediately' vs 'Old key will stay active for 24h (staged)'. Use aria-live when toggled.
Kevin Liu: Backend note: we already support a grace_window param (seconds). We can expose presets: Off (0), Staged (86400), Immediate (0 + revoke flag). API example we return as plain JSON in response body (will include "grace_window").
Aria Gomez: Proposed UI: radio group with three options: Keep active, Staged (24h), Revoke now. Each option has one-line explainer and an inline link "How to choose". Default: Staged.
Maya Chen: Copy proposal for staged: 'Keep old key active for 24 hours to finish rolling updates; new key usable immediately.' For revoke now: 'Old key will stop working immediately; this may cause outages.'
Samir Patel: Also suggest a preview badge that shows "Estimated impact" based on org telemetry (if we can surface how many recent requests used that key). If >100k calls/day show a warning.
Jamie Ortiz: Keyboard & screenreader flow: radio group should be tabbable; when selecting 'Revoke now' put focus on the inline warning and announce it via aria-live=assertive. Escape closes and returns focus to key row.
Kevin Liu: I'll add server-side validation so Immediate revokes require an extra confirm phrase (type the key name) for orgs above threshold. Also log a 'revocation_intent' audit event.
Aria Gomez: Empty state nit: show a sample rotation checklist in the empty keys doc panel: steps for staged rollout, sample CLI commands, and best practices for CI/CD.
Maya Chen: Ops-bot, can you open a single ticket covering: radio-group UX, copy variants, aria-live, preview impact badge, backend grace_window param exposure, confirm-phrase guard, and docs snippet?
ops-bot: Created PROD-1999: "Rotate: staged revocation radios + accessibility + impact preview + backend guard + docs" assigned to @Jamie, @Kevin, @Aria. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-1999
Samir Patel: One more copy thought: use plain English labels not product-y terms. 'Keep old key', 'Delay revoke (24h)', 'Revoke now'.
Jamie Ortiz: I'll mock the radio group and the focus behavior in Figma and attach copy variants.
Maya Chen: Great — let's review in Friday's design sync. :thumbsup:
